parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region in which the WAF instance is deployed. Valid value:

*   **cn-hangzhou**: Chinese mainland.
*   **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: RuleType
parameters.description:
The type of the rule. Valid values:

*   **pullin**: The traffic redirection rule of the hybrid cloud cluster.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-hybrid-cloud-cluster-rule --instance-id waf-cn-uqm33n00002 --cluster-id 1 --rule-type pullin --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --cluster-rule-resource-id hdbc-clusterrule-0000000m0w --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
